name: appsnap
description: Capture a Mac app window as agent context: hover-pick a window, get a high-res screenshot plus Accessibility-tree text. Smart auto mode scroll-stitches scrollable windows into a seamless full-page image (sidebars cropped, ratio-split into readable tiles, silent, manual stop). The screenshot is primary context the agent reads with its own vision; AX text is supplementary. macOS only. No network, no model calls.
author: yrzhe
